posts.name: Gauth Unlimited Digital Canvas
posts.tagline: An AI tutor on an infinite whiteboard, not a chat thread
posts.description: Gauth AI Course now runs on an Unlimited Digital Canvas: one continuous whiteboard where lessons unfold spatially instead of in a chat thread or slide deck. Chapters expand side by side as narration plays, board notes write out in sync with the AI voice, and you can zoom from the full concept map down to a single formula. Pause anytime to ask the AI Tutor, and it answers right on the board beneath your step. Generate a canvas lesson on any topic, then export it as a PDF or share a link.

posts.name: Veltrix AI for E-commerce
posts.tagline: Find how your e-commerce business could earn more
posts.description: Find ways to make your e-commerce business more profitable. Veltrix uses AI to analyze your sales, costs, customers and marketing. Get help deciding what to promote, where to cut spending and how to solve problems holding the business back. Connect your business tools or upload files. Start with a Business Health Check to find improvements you may have missed. Then use Veltrix to work out what to improve. Your first check is free. No card required.

posts.name: Famulor
posts.tagline: Your agent to answer calls and follow ups on WhatsApp
posts.description: Famulor answers calls, runs campaigns and follows up on WhatsApp. GDPR-ready, EU hosting. Try it free.

posts.name: Teachoo
posts.tagline: AI that helps you learn anything and everything.
posts.description: Teachoo helps students work through homework one question at a time. Type a problem or upload a photo, then work toward the answer with guided questions, feedback and hints. Need more help? Ask for a bigger hint or an explanation of the step. Free to use. Try a problem you haven’t solved in years.

posts.name: ShipHQ
posts.tagline: Build your own app studio, powered by your real apps
posts.description: ShipHQ turns your app's real numbers into a living isometric startup office. Connect RevenueCat and every paying subscriber becomes a person at your desks. Each morning the Daily Brief replays last night: new subscribers walk in to applause, trials arrive in caps, churn gets a send-off. Milestones land as trophies on your wall — earned, never bought, never retroactive. AI managers bring a 09:00 standup on growth, reviews and competitors. Free on iPhone.

posts.name: Bambu Lab R1
posts.tagline: CO2 laser cutting with Bambu-style automation
posts.description: Bambu Lab R1 is a 55W CO2 laser cutter built around automation. It handles optical alignment, material positioning and surface tracking for you, with a 600 × 300 mm work area, clear acrylic support, and optional conveyor processing up to 3 meters.

posts.name: Mintlify Desktop
posts.tagline: An AI-native app for writing documentation and knowledge
posts.description: A dedicated home for all your documentation, from internal knowledge bases, runbooks and onboarding guides to public docs. Keep projects open side by side across organizations and pick up where you left off. An agent works alongside you on the page you’re editing, while local files let you write offline and sync when you reconnect. Tabs, split views, and persistent sessions help you move between projects without losing context.

posts.name: Eleven v4 and Eleven v4 Turbo
posts.tagline: Elevenlabs' fastest and most emotive voice models yet
posts.description: Meet Eleven v4 and Eleven v4 Turbo by ElevenLabs, their most expressive models yet, with Turbo built for real-time use. Available in apps, API, and agents.

posts.name: Clef
posts.tagline: Open-source decision models from Cloudflare
posts.description: Clef is a 27B multimodal model that turns a state and a schema of typed questions into decisions. It reads the state as text, JSON, images, or video, and returns a probability for every allowed option of every question in a single forward pass. There is no free-form text generation and no output parsing. The Clef API is fully compatible with Jev and SystemOne.

posts.name: Syllaby AI Avatar 2.0
posts.tagline: Create Your Own Avatar In Seconds
posts.description: Turn a script or simple idea into a complete presenter-led video with a realistic AI avatar, natural voice, B-roll and subtitles—without hiring actors,

posts.name: JarvisCore
posts.tagline: Build agents as peers in a mesh network with zero-trust
posts.description: JarvisCore is a runtime where AI agents operate as a fleet of equal peers. Agents discover one another by capability, execute tasks from a shared ledger, and authenticate to every external service through a zero-trust broker, never with their own keys.

posts.name: Anthroposcaper
posts.tagline: Tag a 2D plan, get a 3D urban environment model
posts.description: Draw a 2D plan in the browser or import a DXF, then tag its faces and lines. Turn your own GLB models into templates, and Anthroposcaper lays them along every matching edge, corners and junctions included, into a textured 3D scene. Change one tag or drawing and the scene rebuilds. Export to GLB for your 3D editor or game engine. Connect your AI agent over MCP: it helps set up templates, configure tags and materials, and keep the project organized. You stay in control of the result.

posts.name: Open Inspector
posts.tagline: Hover any website, get its design system. No permissions.
posts.description: A free, open-source browser extension for inspecting layout, styles, colour, type and assets on any page, and exporting its design tokens. Unlike the popular alternatives, it requests no site access and makes zero network requests. MIT, no account.

posts.name: Communicate
posts.tagline: AI support agents grounded in your knowledge, with handoff
posts.description: Build AI support agents from your help docs, files, and past replies. Answer questions and run tasks you approve, with human handoff in a shared inbox. Add website chat, track conversations, and connect through the API or read-only MCP. Plans start at $19/month. Product Hunt offer: PRODUCTHUNT50 gives 50% off your first monthly plan payment through October 9. A separate lifetime launch offer is available on our website.

posts.name: Cue by Manus
posts.tagline: Personal agents with identity, handling life end to end
posts.description: Whatever life brings, your personal agents on Cue handle it — each with its own email, phone number, wallet and computer to get real work done.

posts.name: Codync
posts.tagline: The open-source alternative to Grok Bot, Muse and Dots
posts.description: Everything Grok Bot, Muse and Dots do, open source and 100% free. Run Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or 40+ agents as named bots on your own computer, then reply and approve from your iPhone, Mac, Linux or terminal. MIT, end-to-end encrypted.

posts.name: Wu
posts.tagline: Fast, native code editor in Rust that feels like VS Code
posts.description: Wu is a code editor for people who want the speed of a native app and the familiarity of VS Code.

posts.name: Never Boring AI
posts.tagline: The AI agent that writes your LinkedIn posts in your voice
posts.description: Never Boring AI is an AI agent for LinkedIn. It interviews you about your work, keeps your stories in memory and turns them into posts written in your voice. It plans your content weeks ahead, learns from every edit you make, then schedules and publishes on LinkedIn for you. Built for freelancers, consultants and founders who know what they do but never know what to post this week. Works in English and French.

posts.name: Lloyal
posts.tagline: Turn open-weight models into AI apps people can download
posts.description: Start with a working TypeScript AI app with built-in inference and a multi-agent runtime. In-app agents can research, read local files, understand documents and compose specialist models. Works offline, no API keys or complicated setup for your users. Customize and ship it to desktop, web or terminal in minutes 🚀

posts.name: Finbar
posts.tagline: Agentic investment research
posts.description: Finbar is launching public availability of its data and research platform to all investors (and their agents) - already used by several of the world's largest hedge funds. Services include: worldwide fundamental data via API/MCP; prebuilt company models and primers; and a complete AI suite for research and modelling (on web and in Excel).

posts.name: Earlyn
posts.tagline: Searchable memory of your screen and meetings, on your Mac
posts.description: Earlyn keeps an encrypted, searchable memory of what's on your Mac's screen and in your meetings, and answers questions about your day. Scrub back through a timeline, find any word you saw, get meeting transcripts in any language with live translation, and give Claude Code, Codex or Cursor your context over MCP. Capture, search and transcription run on your Mac; nothing is sent unless you pick a cloud model or connect an app. 7 days free, then $19/month.

posts.name: esigna
posts.tagline: A design studio for your email signature
posts.description: Your email signature should feel as considered as your website. Paste the one you use today, see your details across 26 original templates, then make it yours in a visual editor. Move blocks, refine type and spacing, add your photo, logo and booking link. Preview light, dark and mobile, then copy into Gmail, Outlook or Apple Mail. Free to design and copy. No account needed to start.

posts.name: CodeAF
posts.tagline: Open Source Software Factory
posts.description: CodeAF is a coding harness built for open models, to get the most out of every dollar. Frontier-grade coding on open models, at a fraction of the cost.I t is also a different way to work once more than one thing is going on: instead of three terminals of agents with you in the middle, one window where you hand work off, see what is moving across every project, and step in only where your judgment is needed.

posts.name: Pastily
posts.tagline: Your clipboard but better
posts.description: Fast, private clipboard manager for macOS, Windows and Linux. Searchable copy history, paste queue, images and snippets. 100% offline, pay once.

posts.name: Moxie
posts.tagline: Use any AI with Claude Code, switch accounts mid-task
posts.description: Moxie is a Mac menu bar app for Claude Code. Use your ChatGPT plan, Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter or local models in Ollama, all from the Claude Code you already use. posts.name: Globestudio
posts.tagline: Open-source dotted maps and 3D globes for designers
posts.description: A free, open-source studio for dotted maps and 3D globes. Pick the world or any country, choose one of 21 shader looks, tweak the dots, gradients and density, then export a PNG, SVG, WebM, MP4 or GIF, or embed it live. It's MIT licensed, with no account.

posts.name: GitSync
posts.tagline: Sync branches between GitHub repos, right from Chrome
posts.description: GitSync is a Chrome extension that copies a branch from one GitHub repo to another you have access to — with full commit history or just the latest snapshot, into an existing or brand-new branch. Runs entirely in your browser; no GitSync server sees your code.

posts.name: WeftCut
posts.tagline: The open-source video editor your AI agent can drive

posts.name: Halo
posts.tagline: Dynamic Island for Mac, plus external monitor control

posts.name: Sayonic
posts.tagline: A voice assistant in your Mac's notch that does the task
posts.description: Sayonic lives in your Mac's notch. Say what you want and it opens apps and tabs, finds files, adds notes and events, or hands the job to a coding agent you already use. From $3.99 a month per Mac with your own keys, or Pro and Max with Cloud credits included.

posts.name: slash-editor
posts.tagline: Notion-style block editor for React. MIT, UI you own
posts.description: slash-editor gives your React app the Notion block experience: a slash menu, drag handles, nested reorder, turn-into, comments and real-time collab. It runs on a headless Tiptap v3 core. The UI arrives through a shadcn registry, so the components land in your repo and follow your Tailwind tokens. Tables, columns, Mermaid, AI via your own model, markdown import/export. MIT end to end, no paid tier, nothing hosted.

posts.name: Audryo
posts.tagline: Customer email your agent can operate.
posts.description: Audryo is lifecycle email built for AI agents. Connect Claude Code, Codex or Cursor via MCP, API or CLI. posts.name: Ranks Hawk
posts.tagline: Rank faster than the competitors you're spying.
posts.description: Your competitors have entire SEO teams to create a content strategy. You don't need one. Use Ranks Hawk to monitor all their activity and steal what works. posts.name: Corda Marketing
posts.tagline: AI-powered authority intelligence for modern search
posts.description: The link-building industry faces persistent challenges: limited quality placements, inefficient outreach, rising costs, inconsistent ROI, and fragmented workflows. Corda solves these challenges at the intelligence layer. Corda is an AI-powered authority intelligence platform connecting brand, competitor, and publisher data to identify gaps, discover opportunities, recommend campaigns, and track performance—turning fragmented authority building into intelligent, data-driven decision-making.

posts.name: MRT Announcements
posts.tagline: A talking Singapore MRT map for little train fans
posts.description: An interactive Singapore MRT map for little train fans. Tap any of 143 stations to hear it announced, then the doors closing. Made by a mum for her son.

posts.name: ChickyTutor

posts.description: Free score tracker for your mahjong game. Create leaderboard, trend charts and head-to-head records for your friend group or club. No sign-up, No install. Supports all kind of Mahjong.

posts.name: The Bayeux Tapestry online experience
posts.tagline: Explore the 70-metre Tapestry online
posts.description: The Bayeux Tapestry has returned to England for the first time since it was made, nearly a thousand years ago. To widen access and help people explore the Tapestry in more detail, the British Museum commissioned Numiko to create an interactive online experience. The result of this project is The Bayeux Tapestry Online Experience, a free interactive experience that you can use to explore the full length of the Tapestry in close detail.

posts.name: AI Usage Tracker
posts.tagline: Every AI limit. Right in your notch.
posts.description: Always-on-top Windows edge pill showing your Claude, Codex, Cursor, FreeBuff, Github Copilot and Antigravity limits - aswin-dg/usage-meter-for-windows

posts.tagline: Score any resume against any job, with quoted evidence
posts.description: An API for recruiting tools. Send a job description and a resume (PDF, DOCX, HTML or TXT); get a 0–100 score, a verdict for each screening question and the exact resume line behind it. An LLM writes the questions once; a classification model (TypeSafe Jev) answers them for every resume, 8× faster and 31× cheaper than an LLM. 50 free scores, then $0.10. Open-source demo on GitHub.

posts.name: Releasy Suite
posts.tagline: Every signal from your product, in one place.
posts.description: Hookfire, Upvoted and Indie Polls in one place. Alerts from your stack, feature voting from your users, and embeddable polls. One login, one bill, $69/mo.

posts.name: Remote Jobs Work From Home

posts.tagline: Free MP3 to MP4 Video Maker for Android & Windows
posts.description: Turn MP3 audio into eye-catching MP4 videos with animated music visualizers, custom covers, titles, descriptions, Google Fonts, and flexible layouts. Create videos in 1:1, 9:16, or 16:9, with 720p or 1080p export. Perfect for music, podcasts, voice recordings, YouTube, Shorts, Reels, and social media. Available on Android and Windows.

posts.name: Habit8
posts.tagline: Track 8 habits. See what’s actually working.
posts.description: Most apps encourage you to track more and more habits.But we wanted a focused system around the 8 habits that matter most to you. Habit8 lets you track your consistency, uncover patterns, and understand how your habits actually perform over time. The Eight Map gives you a bigger picture, while performance insights help you understand where you're improving and where you might be losing consistency. The goal isn't to build the perfect routine. It's to build a system you can actually stick with.

posts.name: inklet Portal
posts.tagline: Turn saved notes into glanceable desktop cards.
posts.description: inklet is building a quieter home for your digital mind. inklet Portal uses AI to turn notes, links, images, and PDFs into clear, glanceable cards on your Mac desktop, inklet Display D1, or Quote/0. Capture with a shortcut, find everything in a searchable library, and start without buying hardware. We believe the information you need should find you, not the other way around.

posts.name: LitoAI
posts.tagline: Chat, voice, memory — and a coding agent for Windows
posts.description: LitoAI is a personal AI assistant ecosystem: one account, one memory, three surfaces — web, Android, and LitoCode, a coding agent for Windows. Chat with streaming answers, real-time voice over WebRTC, user-controlled semantic memory, image & video generation, web research, autonomous agents, scheduled routines and a privacy mode that never persists. LitoCode (private beta) maps your project, plans multi-file edits and verifies results locally, with visible permissions.

posts.name: Alcove
posts.tagline: A calmer new tab page
posts.description: A calmer new tab page: your own wallpaper, the links you actually use, and small tools that open when you need them.

posts.name: LitoAI
posts.tagline: Chat, voice, memory — and a coding agent for Windows
posts.description: LitoAI is a personal AI assistant ecosystem: one account, one memory, three surfaces — web, Android, and LitoCode, a coding agent for Windows. Chat with streaming answers, real-time voice over WebRTC, user-controlled semantic memory, image & video generation, web research, autonomous agents, scheduled routines and a privacy mode that never persists. LitoCode (private beta) maps your project, plans multi-file edits and verifies results locally, with visible permissions.

posts.name: MAKOVA
posts.tagline: The sales suite for digital products sold by teams
posts.description: What's different: every platform here assumes the creator sells alone. Makova is built for digital products sold by commercial teams, with Setter/Closer attribution in the data model rather than bolted on. What stands out: - One checkout across 5 gateways, built for how LATAM pays - Commission rules per project and per role, liquidated automatically - CRM plus a member area with courses and community - NOVA Copilot: lead scoring, daily briefs, forecast, AI recovery messages

posts.name: DockLens
posts.tagline: See every window of an app by hovering its Dock icon
posts.description: DockLens shows live thumbnails of all an app's windows when you hover its Dock icon. Click a thumbnail to switch, or close, minimize and full-screen windows right from the preview. Windows you closed with the X button (Notion, Slack...) stay listed so one click brings them back, and Spotify / Music get a playback bar. Free, open source (GPLv3), no network access, 0% CPU when idle. macOS 26+.

posts.name: ParkLive —  Live Parking Signals
posts.tagline: Live parking signals from drivers near you
posts.description: ParkLive is a community-powered parking network. Drivers signal when they leave a spot, helping nearby drivers discover fresh parking leads instead of circling the block and guessing.

posts.name: RouteCord
posts.tagline: Transfer Discord voice between channels. Record each person.
posts.description: RouteCord lets you route audio between Discord voice channels and record each participant on a separate track. It runs in your browser using your own Discord bots. Built for recording sessions, streams, and games like Werewolf.

posts.name: PixSip
posts.tagline: Private image compression, right in your browser
posts.description: Compress JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and HEIC images in your browser, and convert them to AVIF, JPEG XL, WebP, JPG or PNG. No uploads, no signup, no watermark.

posts.name: Frasco
posts.tagline: Decision fatigue is over. Nobody decides. The jar does.
posts.description: Frasco kills the “what are we doing?” loop. Everyone adds ideas for Eat, Do, and Watch, then you shake the jar and let chance decide. Hate the pick? Pull another. Join with a link + 4-digit PIN — no email, app, passwords, or credit card. Includes full-night picks, hidden ideas, budget mode, and AI suggestions. Free, ad-free, for couples, roommates, and friends. I built this because my partner and I kept looping on dinner. https://frasco.fun/en?utm_source=producthunt&utm_medium=launch

posts.name: Bisa
posts.tagline: A Decentralized Agentic IDE
posts.description: One desktop app for the coding agents you already use — Claude Code, Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, OpenCode and more: a Project IDE where they work beside you, agents and teams to staff the work, workflows you read before they run, and goals you come back to. No server and no account: your workspace lives on your machine, your identity is a Nostr key, and the people you invite meet you over relays that carry only ciphertext.

posts.name: Leveld
posts.tagline: Stay on top of work and life - your AI project manager
posts.description: Whether you're running a multi-million-pound project or just your personal admin, every ask you send or receive should be logged, followed through and closed. That's Leveld. It reads your email, documents actions and decisions, flags risks like an expert over your shoulder, and chases the overdue with one click — you stay in control. Not inbox zero. Not another chatbot. A clean, separate space with the list you've always wanted. Gmail now, more soon. Free beta, 20 spots.

posts.name: Konsole
posts.tagline: Work on a copy of your website. Publish when it's ready.
posts.description: Konsole runs your WordPress or PHP site on your own Mac. Bring it home from your server, change anything without risk, then send back only what changed, over FTP, SFTP or SSH. No Docker or command line needed. Free for 3 sites.

posts.name: Senviok
posts.tagline: Email and SMS infrastructure for builders and AI agents
posts.description: Senviok is a developer-first Resend alternative for transactional email, SMS, and OTPs. One REST API or SDK gives you unified logs, local billing, and built-in SPF, DKIM, and DMARC setup.

posts.name: Needlee
posts.tagline: Everything you need to keep track of your pattern progress
posts.description: Upload a pattern, map its grid, then mark the stitches as you work them. Daily goals and weekly totals keep your progress clear.

posts.name: ScreenToast
posts.tagline: Turn your Mac screen recording into a product demo
posts.description: ScreenToast is a Mac screen recorder for product demos: auto zoom on clicks, a smooth cursor, vertical recording and drafted narration. Free until you export.

posts.name: Allowly
posts.tagline: Policy checks and signed receipts for AI agent actions
posts.description: Allowly checks your rules before an AI agent sends, spends, publishes, changes, or deletes. Get an allow, deny, confirm, or escalate decision and a signed receipt you can verify offline. Connect through API, Python, TypeScript, MCP, n8n, Make, or Zapier. Your integration executes only allowed actions. Start free with 1,000 decisions; no card required.

posts.name: OriginPage
posts.tagline: Private document AI with sources you can check
posts.description: OriginPage is a Windows 11 app for searching PDFs, Word files, and notes and asking questions across them. Document processing and AI run on your PC. Choose which files an answer can use, then open the exact passage behind each cited claim.

posts.name: Fantasy Football AI Weekly Recaps
posts.tagline: AI-written trash-talk recaps, texted to your league
posts.description: Fantasy Sports Reports turns your league’s real weekly matchups into a hilarious, trash-talking recap written by AI and texted straight to your commissioner every week. Connect your ESPN or Sleeper league in seconds, and every Tuesday your commish gets a ready-to-paste recap that keeps the group chat roasting all season. No spreadsheets, no writing, just vibes. And it’s completely free.

posts.name: Pausean: Calm Focus Timer
posts.tagline: Put your phone down, breathe
posts.description: Pausean is a calm focus timer for iPhone. Set your minutes, turn your phone face down, and feel three slow breaths as your time begins. Every quiet stretch becomes a stone in your collection, and every duration shapes its own kind of stone. Need your phone? Pick it up. Your time keeps running for 60 seconds. No blocking, no streaks, no guilt. Just a quiet way to put your phone down and see what that time adds up to.

posts.name: Afflemi
posts.tagline: Find affiliate programs, or find affiliates to promote yours
posts.description: Afflemi is where affiliates and brands find each other. Affiliates browse hundreds of programs by category, compare commission, cookie length and payout terms, and join the affiliate map for free so brands can find them. Brands list their program once for $29.99, or add Recruit for $49.99 a month: a private board to browse affiliates, unlock contact details and keep a shortlist. Every affiliate verifies their websites, and their details stay private until an approved brand unlocks them.

posts.name: Hadir
posts.tagline: A quiet prayer companion for your Mac’s notch
posts.description: Hadir helps Muslim professionals keep up with prayer while they work on Mac. It lives quietly in the menu bar and notch, showing the next prayer, daily prayer times, Hijri dates, reminders, and Du’a & Dhikr. No noisy dashboard. Just a calm reminder when it matters.
